# Check image-engine records against the bridge's limits

A record the bridge refuses parks the worker; the next image-engine use hangs.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Read the bridge checks (capacity, frame counts) for every change made to a job record before submitting it.

> **What happens:** Camera hang the next time anything uses the image processor, until the battery is pulled.

**Symptoms:** [Freezes until the battery is pulled](index.md#freeze)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): A record over the bridge's capacity hung an E-M5 III until a battery pull. Source: [E-M5 III image engine (technical notes)](../sources/em5n.image-engine.md).
